tune.title: Fonts outweigh everything else on the page
tune.why: 136.3 KB of fonts against 33.2 KB of JS on /; largest fraunces-400-latin-b7881128.woff2 at 117.4 KB. Same in every variant, so a default to win, not a gap: subset harder, and check the LCP text isn't waiting on it.

tune.title: LCP: render delay is the largest phase
tune.why: 1.5 mobile points lost to LCP on /. Really throttled: element render delay 2187ms, time to first byte 8ms. Lantern, which sets the score: time to first byte 451ms, load delay 525ms, load duration 3ms, render delay 1274ms. Element: <h1 id="hero-title" class="mt-6 font-display text-display-xl font-medium text-balance">. The LCP element is in the HTML but paints late: look at what blocks it, usually render-blocking CSS, webfont swap, or a hidden state lifted by hydration.
